recipes.title: Brioche Protein French Toast with Dark Chocolate (20 slices)

items.i: medium brioche loaves, thickly sliced (20 slices)

steps: Whisk the eggs, egg whites, cinnamon, stevia and vanilla.
Dip each brioche slice in the custard, letting it soak briefly.
Cook in a hot, lightly greased skillet until golden on both sides.
Drizzle with melted dark chocolate and dust with powdered sugar if you like.
Cool, then refrigerate a few days or freeze; reheat in a toaster, skillet or air fryer.
recipes.notes: Recipe and macros are the creator's, per slice. As he says, not low calorie, but a protein-boosted treat breakfast.
